notes.title: [v0.4.18] Keyboard + Controller + Steam Deck Support
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, everyone!

Controller and Steam Deck support is finally in!
Getting controller navigation to behave intuitively for every situation was tricky, and it took awhile.
(Doing QA-testing for the game now also takes longer, as I have to test multiple input methods.)

There are a few minor improvements I'd like to make, but overall I'm quite happy with how it handles.
In some ways I even prefer it over mouse controls!

There are also minor improvements to the tutorial; it's an ongoing effort.

Moving forward, I'm hoping to release updates more often!

Cheers,
DY

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.12
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is a relatively small but significant update.
Star tokens have been removed.
Now, at the end of each act, you get to spend the gold you've accumulated at a special shop.

When you buy an item from this special shop, you also get a global item slot!
Any unspent gold will be converted into Combo tokens for the next act.

The total gold you have at the end of the final act will be your final score.

I'll still have to refine the presentation a bit, but I think this simplifies the structure and "goal" of the game.

Cheers,
DY

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.11
notes.notes:
Hello!

In v0.4.11, I added more tokens and items that enable item synergies!
But first, let's talk about a few simplifications.

[h3]Changes to Existing Tokens[/h3]
The "Damage Up" token has been renamed to simply "Damage".
The use of "DAMAGE" in item descriptions have been replaced with the same Damage icon.

The "Backstab" token has been renamed to "Surprise", and now applies for non-damage efffects too!

The "Lightning" token has been renamed to "Speed", and the "Frost" token has been removed.
Item effects that modify cooldowns now simply say +/- Speed.

[h3]New Tokens and Items[/h3]
Two new tokens have been added to the game.

[i]Mastery: Item effects +1 for each Mastery after use. Lasts till next encounter.[/i]
Because Mastery works with any item effect with a number, it has some surprising synergies!

[i]Sacrifice:  Gain 1AP and lose 1HP for each Sacrifice after use.[/i]
Sacrifice could be either good or bad, depending on the situation!

I'd originally planned to add these new mechanics as "keywords" that get attached to items.
But as I started implementing them, I realized that they are really similar to tokens, and I should just make them tokens instead!

Anyways! A bunch of new items have also been added, many of which utilize these new tokens!

[h3]UI[/h3]
As a result of introducing many new passive items, I've added UI elements to show buffs/debuffs that apply to the selected item.
I've also moved item tokens to the top right corner of the description.
Definitely needs more work though; there have been occasions when even I, as the developer, got confused.

[h3]Others[/h3]
- You can now press Esc even while animations are playing, which will bring up the menu and pause the game.
- Too many bug fixes to list.

[h3]Conclusion[/h3]
Up to this point, the game hasn't had as many item synergies as I'd hoped.
(And not for the lack of trying!)
Personally, it's the most glaring issue with the game, and with this update I wanted to take another shot at it.

Overall I think this update is a step in the right direction.
Lots more to be done!

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.10
notes.notes:
Hello!

New patch is up!

There's a critical bug that causes the game to crash on the first frame, if the save format changes between versions.
(It will appear as though the game failed to launch.)
It's dependent on what data had been saved previously, so the crash doesn't always happen.
I should've caught it earlier, but it's fixed now.
Thanks to everyone who reported it and helped me debug the issue!

Also, I've made several improvements to the tutorial.
The focus was to make sure the player understands how to use an item, which can be broken down into 3 steps:
1. Select the unit
2. Select the item from the unit's inventory
3. Select a target for the item

I didn't want to do the common way of having a giant arrows telling you where to click next.
I think that sets up the wrong expectation that the game will hand-hold you.
On the other hand, it's important to ease new players smoothly into the game!

I've currently settled on a sort of middle ground:
- You can't deselect the unit or item once you've selected them
  - I've noticed that new players often misclick, which causes an unintended deselection and is confusing/frustrating
  - This ensures that they are always making forward progress in the 3 steps
  - (Once they've successfully used an item for the first time, deselection is restored)
- If they misclick, the next thing they are supposed to click on will pulse, and an error sound will play
- The nice thing about this approach is that these "hints" will only show for players who need them

(If you want to try out the changes to the tutorial, you can DELETE ALL DATA in the settings menu on the top left.)

Other minor changes:
- Tweaked the Jazz Hands item so that you can now target yourself, and you can't select invalid swap targets.
- Minor visual effect when you click around on the background

Cheers,
DY

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.9
notes.notes:
Sorry, it's been awhile since the last update!
Went on holiday, but also there was a big refactor that took longer than expected.
The code that processes item effects is now a lot simpler, and I uncovered several subtle edge case bugs along the way.
There might still be a few lingering issues, but the system should be more robust and flexible now.

I also decided that the old "TICK!" texts weren't quite working.
I prototyped several ideas, including this weird idea of spawning "tick tokens" that you have to pick up.
(I might bring it back, but it won't be the main way you recharge your cooldowns.)
I've finally settled on replacing the "TICK!" stuff with a clock icon/animation instead.
Still not very happy with the animation, but overall I think it looks cleaner now, and less confusing hopefully.

Also added a couple of new items!

notes.title: Update Notes for v0.4.8
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been awhile since the last update; there were quite a lot of changes I wanted to squeeze into this new version.
I'll just highlight a few of the major ones here.

Changes:
- You can no longer "cheese" the bossfights by pre-emptively killing off your party members, or throwing away items on purpose.
  - I'll leave you to discover the details!
    - (It's still possible to cheese the secret fight in the final Act, but that will probably be patched over in the next version.)
  - Normally I'd prefer to leave these sorts of exploits in the game for players to discover, but in this case the exploit makes the game too unfun.
- There's now an angel shop at the start of subsequent acts, where you can spend stars to unlock items.
- The shopkeeper now spawns with a random item that has yet been unlocked. 
- Reworked the score tally scene so it's less embarrassingly ugly
- You can now see how much an item's cooldown was modified by in the item descriptions
- Items now deal knockback damage as well
- Tons of minor bugfixes and UI improvements

Known Issues:
- Widescreen monitor issues (Haven't had time to investigate more.)
- The slots for global items can sometimes overlap with the shopkeeper's inventory slots

notes.title: Update notes for v0.4.4
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thanks for helping to playtest the game!
The next few updates will probably be focused on addressing some of the confusion/feedback based on the recent playtests.
(The victory and game over screens are placeholders for now.)

Score is currently represented using the Star icon, which I know is a little weird.
I'd been experimenting with having shopkeepers that specialize in different currencies (Gold, Hearts, Stars)
Unfortunately they didn't work very well, so I'm setting the feature aside for now.

Changes:
- Your run's score will now be shown on the top right corner after the first Act.
- Restored partial support for controllers. (Better to stick with mouse controls for now!)
- Game now runs on Steam Deck. (Work in progress)
- Enemy's inventory no longer maximizes when you click on their intended items. (Less confusing for beginners hopefully.)
- Improved clarity when previewing movement effects
- Switch to using tooltips when hovering over THROW and UPGRADE buttons
- Added a DELETE ALL DATA button to make it easier to test the tutorial.
- Fixed z order bug for Language settings dropdown menu
- Fixed z hover bug when inventory details buttons overlap with another unit's inventory slots

Let me know if you have suggestions or questions!

Cheers,
DY
